Apple Reportedly Cuts iPhone 18 Pro Production Due to Soft Demand

Apple has reportedly instructed some suppliers to reduce component orders for its newly launched iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max models. This decision is attributed to dampened consumer demand, influenced by soaring memory chip costs and price increases. Nikkei Asia reported on Friday, October 9, that the tech giant has become more conservative regarding shipments.
